name: custom-visuals-marketplace
description: Custom Visuals Marketplace: the Power BI visuals on Microsoft Marketplace, ranked and explored. A Fabric app built with Rayfin that reads published data files.
author: DataChant

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
scripts.build:pages: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:pages --

rayfinScriptBases.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
rayfinScriptBases.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
